zh.summary: 把已確認規格、允許範圍、驗證命令與停止條件交給 Agent，讓每次修改可審查、可驗收。
objectives: 撰寫只涵蓋一個切片的 Agent 任務。
明確指定可改檔案、可用工具及歧義處理。
用實際 Diff 與命令結果判斷完成狀態。

readingGuide.goal: 撰寫只涵蓋一個切片的 Agent 任務。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 自己的 starter 專案、已確認 problem.md／spec.md／architecture.md，以及教師事先測試可用的 Agent。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 一份可重用任務與對應審查紀錄，能指出至少一項需要人類決定的歧義。

sections.heading: 本次要學會的判斷
paragraphs: 本課屬於 M07；本次只委派本機表單切片，後續再建立檢核與匯出。先確認規格、範圍及實際權限，再以證據決定是否接受成果。

sections.heading: 一、先用一句白話理解
paragraphs: AI Agent 就像一個能力很強、動作很快，但可能自行補充假設的工作夥伴。你不能只告訴它要做什麼，還必須交代哪些事情不能做、遇到什麼情況要停下來，以及做完後要拿什麼證明。
例如，你請裝潢師傅：
「幫我把廚房整理得更好用。」
師傅可能覺得應該拆牆、換水管、重新做櫥櫃，甚至連客廳都一起改。
但你真正的需求可能只是：
「在現有廚房增加兩個收納抽屜，不更動水電，預算不超過兩萬元，施工前先確認尺寸，完成後檢查抽屜能否正常開關。」
兩種指令的差別，就是這一節要教你的核心：從模糊的委託，變成有邊界、有驗收標準、有停止條件的工作契約。
這不只適用於 Coding Agent，也適用於文件整理、研究分析、金融作業、醫療行政，以及其他需要 AI 協助執行的工作。

sections.heading: 二、整個觀念其實只有一條主線
paragraphs: 1. 人類確認規格（Specification）
定義什麼才算做對、哪些規則已被確認
2. 訂定工作契約（Task Contract）
明確指定任務範圍、工具、驗收與停止條件
3. AI Agent 執行
在實際授予的權限內操作，保留紀錄
4. 提供證據（Evidence）
呈現檔案差異、測試結果、未完成事項
5. 人類審查與驗收
接受成果、退回修正，或先釐清需求
這是一個閉環：AI 不只是接收指令和交出成果，而是必須讓負責人有辦法檢查它究竟做了什麼。這也符合教材所強調的「可核對的委派閉環」。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜可核對的五步委派閉環
blocks.description: 四個向下箭頭表示本次委派的工作順序；最後由人類接受、退回修正或釐清需求，必要時回到規格與契約。圖中不另畫回線，也不代表已完成驗收。

items.title: 1. 人類確認規格（Specification）
items.body: 定義什麼才算做對、哪些規則已被確認

items.title: 2. 訂定工作契約（Task Contract）
items.body: 明確指定任務範圍、工具、驗收與停止條件

items.title: 3. AI Agent 執行
items.body: 在實際授予的權限內操作，保留紀錄

items.title: 4. 提供證據（Evidence）
items.body: 呈現檔案差異、測試結果、未完成事項

items.title: 5. 人類審查與驗收
items.body: 接受成果、退回修正，或先釐清需求

sections.heading: 三、工作契約需要交代哪些內容？
paragraphs: 可以把每次交給 Agent 的任務，拆成八個要素。

blocks.caption: 表格｜要素 / 例子
rows: 能使用哪些工具及資源？
三欄可輸入，能顯示內容
業務規則不明確時先詢問

paragraphs: 其中最容易被忽略的是最後三項：驗收、停止、證據。
因為一般人很習慣交代工作目標，卻很少交代「哪些事沒有權力自己決定」。
舉例來說，假設銀行要 AI 協助製作徵信報告。
你只說「幫我產生一份完整報告」，AI 可能自己發明評分標準，並填入看似合理的財務判斷。
但是銀行內部的風險分類和授信標準是正式業務規則。AI 不應該靠猜測決定。
正確的委派方式是：使用已核准的資料和模板；遇到未定義的評估規則，就標示待確認；不能自己編造一項銀行政策。
這個觀念稱為 Human-in-the-Loop（人在決策迴路中）：AI 可以完成被授權的工作，但重要決策仍由具責任與權限的人確認。

sections.heading: 四、為什麼一定要把大任務拆小？
paragraphs: 教材提到一個重要概念：垂直切片（Vertical Slice）。
假設你要開發餐廳訂位系統。
你可以一口氣要求 AI：
「幫我做一套完整的餐廳訂位平台。」
這樣很容易產生大量功能，包括會員登入、桌位安排、付款、簡訊通知、後台管理，甚至可能有根本沒經過確認的訂位規則。
更穩定的方法，是一次完成一個可以獨立驗收的小成果。

blocks.caption: 表格｜切片 / 如何驗收
rows: 姓名、人數、日期輸入介面
只顯示符合條件的桌位
成功建立一筆訂位紀錄

paragraphs: 注意：每一片不只是某個技術元件，而是能展示一段有意義的使用者行為。
如果第一片就出錯，你只需要調查輸入表單，而不是同時檢查付款、資料庫、通知與所有訂位邏輯。
教材 M07-02 也是如此：本次只做表單，後續課程再分別建立資料檢核和匯出功能。

sections.heading: 五、實際上要怎麼向 Coding Agent 下指令？
paragraphs: 教材使用四份重要的專案文件。

blocks.caption: 表格｜文件 / 主要用途
rows: 說明為什麼需要這套系統、要解決什麼問題
定義應有的功能、行為與驗收規則
說明系統結構、元件及技術邊界
說明 Agent 在這個專案中的協作規則

paragraphs: 這些檔案不是要讓 AI 自己發明制度，而是讓不同次執行都能依據相同的專案知識工作。
以下是依照教材精神整理的實際任務範例。

blocks.heading: 可複製的 Agent 任務範例
paragraphs: 保留原稿任務；範例尚未執行。
blocks.code:
你是協助開發本機資料檢核工具的 Coding Agent。

【先閱讀】
problem.md
spec.md
architecture.md
AGENTS.md

如果檔案不存在或無法讀取，請如實回報，
不要宣稱已經閱讀。

【本次目標】
只完成第一個垂直切片：
建立三個有標籤的資料輸入欄位，
讓使用者可以查看目前輸入內容。

【允許修改】
app.py
tests/

【禁止修改與新增】
不得修改 reference/
不得新增登入、資料庫、報告下載或外部 API。
不得使用真實個資。

【驗收標準】
1. 三個欄位均可輸入。
2. 可以查看目前輸入內容。
3. 畫面明確標示「尚未檢核」。
4. 不得呈現「資料完整」等未經驗證的結論。

【停止條件】
如遇到規格未定義的必要欄位或正式業務規則，
不得自行假設。
請提出具體問題，停止受影響的修改。

【完成回報】
1. 實際修改了哪些檔案
2. 每個檔案修改了什麼
3. Diff 的重點
4. 實際執行了哪些測試命令
5. 測試結果及失敗原因
6. 尚未驗證的事項

paragraphs: 注意，這是給 Agent 的工作說明，不是已經執行成功的紀錄；檔名與測試命令應依實際專案調整。

blocks.heading: 文字約束與技術約束
paragraphs: 從執行權限判斷能否強制限制行為。
告訴 AI「不能修改某個檔案」，不代表它在技術上真的沒有修改權限。
這要區分兩種約束：

blocks.caption: 表格｜層次 / 作用
rows: 讓 AI 理解哪些行為不被允許
用檔案權限、沙箱（Sandbox）、工具白名單等機制，實際限制行為

paragraphs: 就像公司交代新進員工「不能進財務室」，這是管理規則；而財務室需要門禁卡才能開門，才是技術控制。
兩者應同時存在。OWASP 對 AI Agent 的安全建議也強調最小權限（Least Privilege）及高影響操作的人類審核。

sections.heading: 六、遇到問題時，Agent 該自行修正，還是停下來？
paragraphs: Agent 應依問題性質決定是否需要人類介入。
要區分「需求歧義」與「實作錯誤」。
情境 A：需求歧義（Requirement Ambiguity）
一間學校要建立學生請假系統，但沒有說明請假超過三天是否需要額外核准。
AI 不應該自行訂定校規，而要提出問題，請負責人確認。
處理：暫停受影響功能，確認規則後再繼續。
情境 B：實作錯誤（Implementation Error）
規格已經要求顯示「請假開始日期」，但畫面卻顯示「入學日期」。
這不是需要重新決定規則的問題，而是程式寫錯。
處理：Agent 可在授權範圍內修正，並驗證修改。
因此，停止條件的設計不能過度僵硬。
如果只是修正拼字或既定範圍內的程式錯誤，不需要每次都停下來要求核准。
但如果會新增正式政策、擴大資料存取、產生支出、刪除重要資料或部署到正式環境，就應該依事先定義的權限和核准規則處理。

blocks.caption: 圖 2｜依問題性質決定修正或停下來
blocks.description: 兩種情境是並列的判斷分支，沒有先後箭頭；需求歧義停受影響部分，實作錯誤則在授權範圍修正並驗證。

items.title: 情境 A：需求歧義（Requirement Ambiguity）
items.body:
學校未說明請假超過三天是否需要額外核准。AI 不應自行訂定校規，應提出問題，請負責人確認。
處理：暫停受影響功能，確認規則後再繼續。

items.title: 情境 B：實作錯誤（Implementation Error）
items.body:
規格要求顯示「請假開始日期」，畫面卻顯示「入學日期」。這是程式錯誤，既定規則無須重新決定。
處理：Agent 可在授權範圍內修正，並驗證修改。

sections.heading: 七、AI 說「已完成」，為什麼還不能直接相信？
paragraphs: 假設 AI 告訴你：
「系統已經完成，所有功能均已正常運作。」
這句話本身只是聲明，不是證據。
真正應該確認的是：

blocks.caption: 表格｜AI 的聲明 / 應有的證據
rows: 檔案差異及依賴變更審查

paragraphs: 這裡的 Diff，就是修改前後的差異，例如程式增加了哪些內容、刪除了哪些內容。
而測試又有不同層次。單元測試通過，只能證明特定測試案例符合預期，不能自動證明整個系統沒有問題。
例如要驗證表單，可檢查欄位是否可以輸入、鍵盤能否操作、錯誤資料是否被拒絕，以及資料是否被不當外送。
Anthropic 的 Agent 工程指引也強調，要使用工具執行的真實回饋來判斷進度，並設定停止條件與適當的人類審查。

sections.heading: 八、從不同行業理解這個方法
paragraphs: 以下比較各行業的執行範圍與約束。

blocks.caption: 表格｜行業 / 必須特別約束
rows: 不得自行定義核貸規則
不得擅改正式評分標準
不得改動原始資料或捏造結果
不得任意擴張功能與權限

paragraphs: 共同原則是：
AI 可以負責執行、分析、整理及提出建議，但不應自行取得原本沒有被授予的決策權。
這也是為什麼規格、權限、驗收和追溯性必須一起設計。

sections.heading: 九、最容易犯的四個錯誤
paragraphs: 以下四種常見錯誤各有對應的修正方法。

blocks.caption: 表格｜常見錯誤 / 正確做法
rows: 定義可觀察的成果及驗收標準
一次交付整套複雜系統
拆成可驗收的垂直切片
以為 AGENTS.md 就能保護檔案
同時設定真正的執行權限
AI 說測試通過就當作成功
檢查實際命令與結果，保留未驗事項

paragraphs: 讓 AI 在已確認的邊界內自主工作，並在必要時回到人類決策，可以兼顧執行效率與負責人的決策權。

sections.heading: 十、理解檢核：你會如何設計這份工作契約？
paragraphs: 某家醫院希望讓 AI Agent 開發一套「門診資料整理系統」。
第一階段只要求輸入病患編號、看診日期、科別，以及預覽輸入內容。
但在執行途中，Agent 主動提議：「為了讓功能完整，我順便加入診斷建議、電子病歷資料庫及自動寄送報告功能。」
請你回答：
請用自己的話回答，依任務邊界、權限控制、停止條件、驗收證據四個面向核對；閱讀參考解析不代表已提交作答或通過實作驗收。

exercise.environment: 自己的 starter 專案、已確認 problem.md／spec.md／architecture.md，以及教師事先測試可用的 Agent。
steps: 寫出表單切片的範圍、允許檔案、驗收與停止條件。
交給 Agent，查看它是否先讀來源並只修改允許路徑。
核對回報與 Diff；命令未執行時保留待驗，不進入下一切片。
exercise.expected: 一份可重用任務與對應審查紀錄，能指出至少一項需要人類決定的歧義。
exercise.check: 文字範圍與實際工具權限都需確認；不把規劃、執行與驗收混為一談。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

openChecks.prompt: 這次真正應該交付的垂直切片是什麼？
answer: 只做病患編號、看診日期、科別三欄與輸入預覽，清楚標示尚未檢核；以合成資料示範，不擴張成完整醫療系統。

openChecks.prompt: 你會明確禁止 Agent 做哪兩件事？
answer: 例如禁止新增診斷建議、禁止串接電子病歷資料庫；自動寄送報告也在本次範圍之外。文字禁止事項需搭配實際工具與資料存取權限。

openChecks.prompt: 哪一種情況必須停止相關修改並詢問人類？
answer: 必要欄位或正式業務規則未定義、需要擴大資料存取或取得尚未授予的權限時，列出具體問題，停止受影響修改。規格明確的欄位誤植則可在授權內修正並驗證。

openChecks.prompt: 最後，你會要求提供哪些證據，才能決定是否接受成果？
answer: 要求修改檔案、逐檔說明、Diff、實際測試命令與原始結果、未驗事項，以及三欄輸入／預覽與「尚未檢核」的操作證據；對照範圍與依賴差異，確認未加入診斷、資料庫或寄信。單元測試不代替全程驗收。

en.summary: Give the Agent confirmed specifications, allowed scope, verification commands and stop conditions so each change can be reviewed and accepted.
objectives: Write an Agent task covering one slice only.
Specify editable files, available tools and handling of ambiguity.
Judge completion from actual diffs and command results.

readingGuide.goal: Write an Agent task covering one slice only.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Your starter project, confirmed problem.md/spec.md/architecture.md, and an Agent tested by the teacher before class.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: A reusable task and review record identifying at least one ambiguity requiring a human decision.

sections.heading: The decision you will learn to make
paragraphs: This lesson belongs to M07. Delegate only the local form slice, with validation and export in later lessons. Confirm specification, scope and actual permissions, then use evidence to decide whether to accept the result.

sections.heading: 1. Understand the idea in plain language
paragraphs: An AI Agent resembles a capable, fast colleague who may fill gaps with assumptions. State the goal, prohibited actions, conditions requiring a pause, and the evidence expected at completion.
Imagine asking a contractor:
“Make my kitchen easier to use.”
The contractor might remove a wall, replace pipes, rebuild cabinets, or even remodel the living room.
Your actual requirement might be:

“Add two storage drawers to the existing kitchen. Keep plumbing and wiring unchanged, spend no more than NT$20,000, confirm dimensions before construction, and check that both drawers open and close afterward.”
The difference is a task agreement with boundaries, acceptance criteria and stop conditions. It turns a vague commission into work that a responsible person can review.
This applies to coding agents, document organization, research analysis, financial operations, medical administration and other delegated work.

sections.heading: 2. Follow one delegation loop
paragraphs: 1. Human confirms the specification (Specification)
Define what counts as correct and which rules have been confirmed.
2. Establish a task contract (Task Contract)
Specify scope, tools, acceptance criteria and stop conditions.
3. AI Agent executes
Operate within actually granted permissions and retain records.
4. Provide evidence (Evidence)
Show file differences, test results and unfinished items.
5. Human review and acceptance
Accept the result, request corrections or clarify requirements first.
This is a loop: the responsible person must be able to inspect what the Agent did. Giving instructions and receiving an output are only parts of verifiable delegation.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | A verifiable five-step delegation loop
blocks.description: Four downward arrows show the order within this task. The human accepts, returns corrections or clarifies requirements, returning to specification and contract when necessary. No return edge is drawn; this is not a completed acceptance record.

items.title: 1. Human confirms the specification
items.body: Define correct behavior and identify confirmed rules.

items.title: 2. Establish a task contract
items.body: Specify scope, tools, acceptance and stop conditions.

items.title: 3. AI Agent executes
items.body: Operate within actually granted permissions and retain records.

items.title: 4. Provide evidence
items.body: Show file differences, test results and unfinished work.

items.title: 5. Human review and acceptance
items.body: Accept the result, request corrections or clarify requirements first.

sections.heading: 3. What belongs in a task contract?
paragraphs: Break each delegated task into eight elements.

blocks.caption: Table | Element / Example
rows: Which tools and resources are allowed?
What observable behavior counts as success?
Three editable fields and an input preview
When must the Agent defer a decision?
Ask when a business rule is unclear
What proves the work was done?

paragraphs: Acceptance, stop conditions and evidence are especially easy to omit.
People often state a goal without explaining which decisions the worker has no authority to make.
Consider a bank asking AI to help prepare a credit assessment report.
“Produce a complete report” could prompt the Agent to invent a scoring scheme and plausible financial judgments.
The bank's risk classifications and lending criteria are official business rules. The Agent must not guess them.
Delegate use of approved data and templates. Mark undefined evaluation rules for confirmation instead of inventing bank policy.
This is Human-in-the-Loop: the Agent performs authorized work while consequential decisions remain with a person who has the responsibility and authority to confirm them.

sections.heading: 4. Why split a large task into small slices?
paragraphs: A vertical slice is a small result that can be accepted independently.
Suppose you are building a restaurant reservation system.
You might ask for everything at once:
“Build a complete restaurant reservation platform.”
That may produce membership, seating, payment, SMS, administration and unconfirmed reservation rules together.
A steadier approach delivers one independently reviewable behavior at a time.

blocks.caption: Table | Slice / Acceptance
rows: Inputs can be entered and displayed
One reservation record is created successfully

paragraphs: Each slice demonstrates a meaningful user behavior; a technical component alone may not do so.
If the first slice fails, investigate the input form without simultaneously checking payments, storage, notifications and all reservation logic.
M07-02 follows the same approach: this task covers the form; later lessons add validation and export separately.

sections.heading: 5. How do you instruct a Coding Agent?
paragraphs: The lesson uses four project documents.

blocks.caption: Table | Document / Purpose
rows: Explain why the system is needed and the problem it addresses
Define functions, behavior and acceptance rules
Explain structure, components and technical boundaries
State the project's Agent collaboration rules

paragraphs: These files let separate executions work from shared project knowledge. They do not authorize the Agent to invent organizational rules.
The following task example applies those principles.

blocks.heading: Copy-ready Agent task example
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese task is preserved below; it has not been executed. Read problem.md, spec.md, architecture.md and AGENTS.md, reporting missing files honestly. Build only three labeled inputs and an input preview. Edit app.py and tests/ only; preserve reference/. Exclude login, databases, downloads, external APIs and real personal data. Accept editable fields, a preview and an explicit not-yet-validated label without unverified completeness claims. Pause affected changes for undefined required fields or official rules. Report changed files, per-file changes, diff highlights, actual test commands, results and failure reasons, and pending checks.
blocks.code:
你是協助開發本機資料檢核工具的 Coding Agent。

【先閱讀】
problem.md
spec.md
architecture.md
AGENTS.md

如果檔案不存在或無法讀取，請如實回報，
不要宣稱已經閱讀。

【本次目標】
只完成第一個垂直切片：
建立三個有標籤的資料輸入欄位，
讓使用者可以查看目前輸入內容。

【允許修改】
app.py
tests/

【禁止修改與新增】
不得修改 reference/
不得新增登入、資料庫、報告下載或外部 API。
不得使用真實個資。

【驗收標準】
1. 三個欄位均可輸入。
2. 可以查看目前輸入內容。
3. 畫面明確標示「尚未檢核」。
4. 不得呈現「資料完整」等未經驗證的結論。

【停止條件】
如遇到規格未定義的必要欄位或正式業務規則，
不得自行假設。
請提出具體問題，停止受影響的修改。

【完成回報】
1. 實際修改了哪些檔案
2. 每個檔案修改了什麼
3. Diff 的重點
4. 實際執行了哪些測試命令
5. 測試結果及失敗原因
6. 尚未驗證的事項

paragraphs: This is an instruction for the Agent, not a record of successful execution. Adjust paths and test commands to the actual project.

blocks.heading: Written constraints and technical controls
paragraphs: Check execution permissions to determine which limits are enforced.
Telling the Agent not to modify a file does not remove its technical ability to modify it.
Distinguish two layers of constraint:

blocks.caption: Table | Layer / Function
rows: Enforce limits using file permissions, a sandbox or tool allowlists

paragraphs: Telling an employee not to enter the finance room is a management rule. Requiring an access card enforces the boundary technically.
Use both. OWASP's Agent security guidance covers least privilege and human review for high-impact actions.

sections.heading: 6. Should the Agent fix a problem or pause?
paragraphs: The kind of problem determines whether human input is needed.
Distinguish requirement ambiguity from implementation error.
Scenario A: Requirement Ambiguity
A school requests a leave system but has not specified whether leave exceeding three days requires additional approval.
The Agent must ask the responsible person instead of inventing school policy.
Response: pause affected functionality and resume once the rule is confirmed.
Scenario B: Implementation Error
The specification requires “Leave start date,” but the screen says “Enrollment date.”
The rule is already clear; the implementation is wrong.
Response: correct it within authorization and verify the change.
Stop conditions need enough flexibility to support this distinction.
Spelling fixes and code errors within the agreed scope do not require a fresh approval every time.
New official policy, broader data access, spending, deletion of important data and production deployment follow the authority and approval rules defined for the task.

blocks.caption: Figure 2 | Decide whether to correct or pause
blocks.description: These are parallel decision cases, without sequence arrows. Pause affected work for ambiguous requirements; correct implementation errors within authorization and verify.

items.title: Scenario A: Requirement Ambiguity
items.body:
The school has not specified whether leave exceeding three days needs additional approval. Ask the responsible person instead of inventing policy.
Response: pause affected functionality and resume after confirmation.

items.title: Scenario B: Implementation Error
items.body:
The specification requires “Leave start date,” but the screen says “Enrollment date.” The implementation is wrong; the agreed rule needs no new decision.
Response: correct within authorization and verify the change.

sections.heading: 7. Why is “completed” insufficient evidence?
paragraphs: Imagine an Agent reporting:
“The system is complete and every feature works normally.”
That sentence is a claim. Acceptance needs evidence.
Check the following:
A diff shows changes between versions, including additions and deletions.
Tests also have different scopes. Passing unit tests establishes the behavior covered by those cases; it cannot establish that the entire system has no problems.
For a form, check editable fields, keyboard operation, rejection of invalid data and whether data is sent somewhere it should not go.
Anthropic's Agent engineering guidance discusses real feedback from tool execution, stopping conditions and appropriate human checkpoints.

sections.heading: 8. Apply the method across industries
paragraphs: Compare execution scope and boundaries across industries below.

blocks.caption: Table | Industry / Boundary requiring explicit control
rows: Do not invent loan approval rules
Do not shut equipment down without authorization
Do not fabricate judgments or provisions
Do not change official grading criteria
Do not modify original data or fabricate results
Do not arbitrarily expand features or permissions

paragraphs: The shared principle is:
AI can execute, analyze, organize and suggest within the authority actually granted to it.
Design specification, permissions, acceptance and traceability together so that delegation preserves decision ownership.

sections.heading: 9. Four common mistakes
paragraphs: Each of these four common mistakes has a corresponding correction.

blocks.caption: Table | Mistake / Better approach
rows: Define observable outcomes and acceptance criteria
Delegating an entire complex system at once
Split work into acceptable vertical slices
Inspect actual commands and results, retaining pending checks

paragraphs: Let the Agent work autonomously within confirmed boundaries and return necessary decisions to the human owner. This supports execution while preserving responsibility.

sections.heading: 10. Check your understanding: design the task contract
paragraphs: A hospital wants an AI Agent to develop an outpatient data organizer.
Phase one only asks for patient identifier, visit date and department inputs with a preview of entered values.
During execution, the Agent proposes adding diagnostic suggestions, an electronic medical-record database and automatic report emailing “to make the system complete.”
Answer these questions:
Answer in your own words and review task boundaries, permission controls, stop conditions and acceptance evidence. Reading an explanation does not submit an answer or establish practical acceptance.

exercise.environment: Your starter project, confirmed problem.md/spec.md/architecture.md, and an Agent tested by the teacher before class.
steps: Write the form slice’s scope, allowed files, acceptance criteria and stop conditions.
Give it to the Agent; inspect whether it reads sources and edits only allowed paths.
Compare its report with the diff. Keep unexecuted commands pending and do not advance to the next slice.
exercise.expected: A reusable task and review record identifying at least one ambiguity requiring a human decision.
exercise.check: Confirm both written scope and actual tool permissions. Separate planning, execution and acceptance.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

openChecks.prompt: What vertical slice should this task actually deliver?
answer: Deliver only patient identifier, visit date and department inputs plus an input preview explicitly marked not yet validated. Demonstrate with synthetic data; keep the medical system expansion outside this slice.

openChecks.prompt: Which two actions would you explicitly prohibit?
answer: For example, prohibit diagnostic suggestions and connection to an electronic medical-record database. Automatic report emailing is also outside this scope. Pair written prohibitions with actual tool and data-access limits.

openChecks.prompt: What situation requires stopping affected changes and asking a human?
answer: Ask specific questions and pause affected work when necessary fields or official rules are undefined, or broader data access or ungranted permissions would be needed. A mislabeled field under a clear specification may be corrected and verified within authorization.

openChecks.prompt: What evidence would you request before accepting the result?
answer: Request changed files, per-file explanations, diff, actual test commands and original results, pending checks and observed three-field input/preview behavior with the not-yet-validated label. Inspect scope and dependency changes for unrequested diagnosis, storage or email features. Unit tests do not replace end-to-end acceptance.
